reviews.text: Wonderful experience.Sir Sparky pulls me from the car to the front door.So happy we found Perky Poodle !!

This place is doing gods work- literally! I found a poor stray dog that needed a lot of TLC, and they completely transformed him into looking like a million bucks! Of course, I had taken him to the vet before to get checked out and all of his shots, but perky poodle really made the magic happen! I would recommend them to anyone. Thank you❣️
I would definitely trust my fur babies to perky poodle! Kind thoughtful and considerate, they do an awesome job!
Fantastic staff... very carrying loving knowledgeable..

Don't let the name steer you away. They accept all breeds! :) Took my American Bully for a grooming & she looks lovely! Everyone was so nice and accommodating! Price point was extremely reasonable, and the experience was seamless. They treat your dog as if it were their own.

I’m leaving a one star review because I don’t think my experience was fair. I have a cockapoo puppy who at the time of the grooming was about 17 weeks old and this was her first grooming. The woman who emailed me about the pricing and grooming experience was very kind so I thought this would be a good experience.
First, I want to say I understand that this was my puppies first grooming and it won’t be perfect! I agreed and understood this when I dropped her off. They said they would only groom her as much as she would let them and that they would only do a sanitary grooming if she didn’t let them cut her hair, which I then said was fine with me! So upon picking up my puppy I come in and I say I’m here to pick up my puppy! the employee then goes to the back and is asking everyone which dog was mine and no one knew which kennel my puppy was in. Which I found really odd because every other groomer I’ve ever been to with my goldendoodle they have never done this. He then pulled my puppy out of her kennel opened the door and asked if she was my puppy and I said yes…. Then I see she was barely groomed…. The hair is cut around her eyes, the bottom of her paws, and they completely shaved her private areas bald. Which I also found really odd. I have had sanitary grooming performed on my other doodle and they trim the private area but it has never been completely bald like my puppies was. Then they charge me $96 for a full grooming on my FIVE POUND puppy. She did not get a full grooming and only had a sanitary cut so I should have been charged a sanitary cut.. I will not be bringing my dog back here.
Great folks. Great service. Ali is fantastic. Knew what we wanted.  Furrbaby came home beautiful. Will recommend to all my friends.

It was a early morning walk in without an appointment.. Ali and the staff took good care of my baby boy! Processing was very quick and everyone was very professional and polite.. we will definitely be back for more services.. oh and the pricing are good too. Again thanks Ali and staff!!! U guys rock

I'm not please with the cut my dog recieved yesterday. I'm sorry, but after really looking him over this is awful. I ASKED  NOT TO CUT THE TOP OF HIS HEAD REALLY SHORT. But yet it was done the opposite. Almost to the skin. I show the lady what I wanted and she advise it could be done. Smh
The second photo is what perky Poodle gave.
Never again.
Dropped off Black Russian Terrier with a coat full of fur for grooming. Showed them photos of what I wanted. Came back HOURS later to a dog that looked like a Dauchound. Very disappointed.
Wonderful locally owned and operated grooming business. The staff is very knowledgeable, friendly, and patient.
Everything good until the 3rd visit when the groomer was in a bad mood, however, owner heard my concerns and discounted price, we both decided to go our separate ways. Thanks.

5-star service! Most groomers will take the easy route and shave completely, or completely disregard your direction. The Perky Poodles team was the total opposite in all phases. From communication to grooming, they took diligent and …
The team is so helpful. Pamela is an amazing groomer and always takes such good care of our girls.

Loved how well they took care of my foster puppy Dior, who has a lot of anxiety and is scared of people. They did an amazing job with her and were so patient and kind. I would give 10 stars if I could.
We love the Perky Poodle and so does our dog!
